## Description {#details}

<p>This file contains the IR transform to lower external or indirect calls for the ARM64EC calling convention.</p>


<p>Such calls must go through the runtime, so we can translate the calling convention for calls into the emulator.</p>


<p>This subsumes Control Flow Guard handling.</p>
